failure_codes.finding: The correction at the fact-sheet root did not propagate through the entire chain. scope_core.scope_is_representative_because and reference_research still describe Takeuchi 2023 as a reach-oriented 「実測順位」; research.md itself retains stronger descriptions including 「媒体×到達の強さの実測順位」 and 「個別事例の実測到達数」. The study reports self-declared information sources among 334 attendees, not total reach or channel-attributable reach counts.

The current fact sheet and adopted player-facing Plan A say respondents identified 「チラシ・掲示」 or treat that combined route as the most frequently reported source. Takeuchi's reported survey category was 「チラシ」; schools and childcare facilities describe where flyers were distributed, not a separately measured 「掲示」 response category.

core_back_check notes still pin the current upstream scope to v8 despite explicitly claiming version numbers will no longer be hardcoded. The same notes contain additional pinned upstream filenames, preserving the exact stale-reference failure mode under another resubmission.
